scope: Final scoring of the selected Desk implementation only; no alternate direction was considered.

unitExit.finding: UNIT separates into blue, yellow, orange and black plates; the black key plate leaves last, giving the outgoing theme its own readable event.

bridgeCoveredSwap.finding: The aged sheet reaches opaque edge-to-edge coverage before data-layout-swapped changes, then contracts into the Desk handoff pose. Desktop and mobile covered-swap evidence exposes no old/new mixed frame.

deskEntry.finding: The same visible sheet lands partially folded; native scroll opens its fold, relaxes the crease, resolves wet masthead ink and commits one non-reversing DESK COPY stamp.

sectionEventUniqueness.finding: Lead placement and tape, dealt reading pile with diary-cover opening, torn classified with VACANT strike, owner-book opening with slips, index opening with labels, dealt/postmarked postcards and mail-slot delivery are visually distinct physical events.

narrativeContinuity.finding: One edition moves from print plates to blank bridge, folded desk paper, developed masthead, working-desk clippings and notebooks, correspondence, then final delivery; later events stay committed when scrolling back.

mobile.finding: The 390x844 transition, opening, reduced-motion and every chapter screenshot remain readable without incoherent overlap. Columns and postcards stay in contained horizontal strips while vertical document flow remains native.

reducedMotion.finding: A live preference change finishes the finite transition, shows the settled Desk state, removes empty opening distance, disables transitions/animations and leaves content immediately readable.

remainingRisks: The captured visual set proves 1440x900 and 390x844. Repeat the same transition midpoint and settled-state checks at 360, 768 and 1024 pixels when porting the prototype into the production theme.
The prototype switcher is development-only; keep it absent from production so it cannot compete with the mobile masthead.
gate: PASS. The selected Desk Heavy prototype may proceed to the Builder stage without changing its art direction or weakening the signature transition and chapter events.
